posts.text:
Trump says his tariffs will help US workers, but he may actually be putting them out of a job.

Not only do tariffs make it harder for American companies to source products, but retaliation from our trading partners (like Canada) will shrink export markets.

In a trade war, there are no winners.

posts.text:
The amount the Trump regime has spent waging war on Iran could have...

-Funded free school lunches for every child
-Lowered health insurance premiums for 20 million people
-Doubled the National Park Service budget
-Fully funded public radio and television

...with money left over.

Priorities.
